parameters.help_en: The ID of the swimming lane group
parameters.name: group_id

Code.description_en:
The HTTP status code. Valid values:

2xx: The request was successful.

3xx: The request was redirected.

4xx: A request error occurred.

5xx: A server error occurred
Code.description_zh:
接口状态或POP错误码。取值说明如下：

2xx：成功。
3xx：重定向。
4xx：请求错误。
5xx：服务器错误

ErrorCode.description_en:
The error code. This parameter is returned only if the request fails. For more information, see the Error codes section of this topic.

If the request is successful, the ErrorCode field is not returned.

A failed request returns the ErrorCode field. For more information, see the error code list in this article
ErrorCode.description_zh:
错误码。取值说明如下：

请求成功：不返回ErrorCode字段。
请求失败：返回ErrorCode字段。具体信息，请参见本文的错误码列表

Message.description_en:
The returned message.

success is returned for a successful request.

An error code is returned for a failed request
Message.description_zh:
附加信息。取值说明如下：

请求正常，返回success。
请求异常，返回具体异常错误码

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the request was successful. Valid values:

true: The swimming lane group was successfully deleted.

false: The swimming lane group was not deleted
Success.description_zh:
是否成功。取值说明如下：

true：删除成功。
false：删除失败

TraceId.description_en: The trace ID. Use this ID to query the details of a call
TraceId.description_zh: 调用链ID，用于精确查询调用信息
